Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The agent assumed the book could be handled by extracting a local PDF file named `responsibility_of_intellectuals.pdf`, but no such file was available. This was the first clear error because it moved forward with an unsupported assumption instead of actually obtaining the book text from the DOI/JSTOR source. That led the conversation away from the real task and prevented retrieval of the relevant endnote.
